report_script:
import frappe
from frappe import _

def execute(filters=None):
    columns, data = [], []

    columns = [
        {
            "fieldname": "name",
            "label": _("Candidate Name"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 200
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "status",
            "label": _("Status"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 120
        },
        {
            "fieldname": "email_id",
            "label": _("Email ID"),
            "fieldtype": "Data",
            "width": 180
        }
    ]

    query = """
        SELECT
            name,
            status,
            email_id
        FROM
            `tabCandidate`
        WHERE
            status = %(status)s
    """

    data = frappe.db.sql(query, {"status": filters.get("status")}, as_dict=True)

    return columns, data
